adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the conditional spread for `slug` changed from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which flips when `slug` is written. The adjacent `metadata` line still only writes `requestedSlug` when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is true. As a result, when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, neither `slug` nor `requestedSlug` is set in this create payload (previously `slug` was set), which is a concrete behavior change and can plausibly break org creation if `slug` is required/expected.
